description: This file defines the 'BitArray' class, a utility class for managing a bit array with operations such as setting bits, getting bits, combining arrays, and serialization.

classes.name: BitArray
classes.description: A class representing a resizable array of bits with methods for bit manipulation, combination, and serialization.

methods.name: numWords
methods.description: Calculates the number of 64-bit words needed to store a given number of bits.

methods.name: BitArray
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the bit array with a specified number of bits.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the bit at the specified index to 1; returns true if the bit was changed.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns whether the bit at the specified index is set.

methods.name: bitSize
methods.description: Returns the total number of bits in the array.

methods.name: cardinality
methods.description: Returns the number of bits set to 1.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Performs a bitwise OR with another BitArray.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Performs a bitwise AND with another BitArray.

methods.name: writeTo
methods.description: Serializes the BitArray to a DataOutputStream.

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Deserializes a BitArray from a DataInputStream.
